about: Knack can absorb relics to change his size and combat abilities. Travel through cities, forests and caves, battle a goblin army and uncover the secrets behind the ancient fragments. A second player can join locally as Robo Knack.
CUSA00006.summary: Gather ancient relics and grow into a towering hero.

about: Nathan Drake leaves retirement when a personal debt draws him into another treasure hunt. Explore remote ruins, climb dangerous terrain and fight through a globe-spanning adventure that puts his family and loyalties under strain.
CUSA00341.summary: Follow Nathan Drake on a final search for pirate treasure.

about: Amanda Ripley searches for answers about her mother’s disappearance aboard a deteriorating space station.
With limited resources and few reliable defenses, survival depends on listening, hiding and improvising as hostile people, machines and an unpredictable creature close in.
CUSA00362.summary: Stay unseen while a relentless alien hunts through Sevastopol.

about: Follow Jodie Holmes, a young woman connected to the mysterious entity Aiden. Switch between their abilities, navigate tense encounters and make choices that shape an emotional supernatural story spanning different stages of Jodie’s life.
CUSA00512.summary: Guide two linked souls through one extraordinary life.

about: Travel with Joel and Ellie through abandoned cities and hostile territory in a story about trust and survival. Combine stealth, combat and limited supplies while navigating dangers from infected creatures and other people.
CUSA00556.summary: Two survivors cross a country transformed by infection.

about: Use a variety of weapons and combos against demons while following Dante and Vergil in this Definitive Edition.
CUSA01022.summary: Fight through Limbo as Dante in a reimagined action game.

about: Travel across planets with Ratchet and Clank in a PS4 adventure that revisits their beginnings. Use unusual weapons and gadgets, explore new encounters and take on action sequences built around the duo.
CUSA01073.summary: Blast into a reimagined galactic origin story.

about: Guide Kat through the floating city of Hekseville as she learns to control gravity and pieces together her missing past. Explore streets, walls and open skies while confronting the strange forces threatening her home.
Follow musical lessons and match button prompts to the beat in a colourful rhythm adventure. Join PaRappa’s friends and instructors through an eccentric story built around rapping and timing.
CUSA01555.summary: Keep the rhythm as PaRappa returns with a new set of songs.

about: Travel through the world of Eos as Noctis and his companions. Explore, fight in action-based battles and follow their journey after an attack on their homeland.
CUSA01615.summary: Journey across a kingdom with Noctis and his friends.

about: Use augmentations, stealth and combat to investigate a divided near-future world.
CUSA01836.summary: Uncover a conspiracy as Adam Jensen.

about: Play guitar, bass or drums, or sing along as your band performs a varied rock setlist. Follow a musical career and improvise guitar solos, using supported instrument controllers or a compatible microphone to bring each performance to life.
CUSA02084.summary: Take the stage with your own living-room rock band.

about: Drive a range of performance cars on recreated circuits in Gran Turismo’s PS4 racing entry. Its focus on realistic handling rewards careful braking, clean lines and learning the character of each car.
PSVR is optional for VR Tour; not all racing modes support VR.
CUSA02168.summary: Explore the cars and circuits of Gran Turismo Sport.

about: Investigate a series of murders through a psychological thriller shaped by your decisions. React under pressure and pursue different leads as the choices you make affect who survives and how the mystery ends.
CUSA02356.summary: Follow four intertwined lives in the hunt for the Origami Killer.

about: Coordinate with a squad through cooperative sci-fi battles where friendly fire is always a danger.
CUSA02974.summary: Spread managed democracy across the galaxy.

about: Enter Yharnam as a hunter seeking answers to a spreading plague.
Learn aggressive, precise combat with transforming weapons, explore interconnected streets and ruins, and face formidable creatures in FromSoftware’s dark action role-playing world.
CUSA03173.summary: Hunt the horrors stalking Yharnam’s moonlit streets.

about: This collection brings together the survival-horror adventures Resident Evil and Resident Evil 0.
CUSA03178.summary: Return to the beginnings of Resident Evil.

about: Just Sing combines scored singing with lip-sync performances and customizable music videos. The original game supports up to four performers, with themes and filters for locally saved recordings.
Its smartphone companion app provides microphone and camera input.
CUSA03483.summary: Turn singing and lip-syncing into a music-video party.

about: Join a young boy and the enormous creature Trico on a journey through mysterious ruins.
Guide their growing partnership, solve environmental puzzles and overcome obstacles that require cooperation to uncover the truth behind their surroundings.
CUSA03745.summary: Build trust with Trico and escape an ancient mystery.

about: Explore the underwater city in BioShock and BioShock 2, using weapons and powers to survive its inhabitants. This listing covers the collection's first PS4 package; BioShock Infinite is separate.
CUSA03985.summary: Return to Rapture in the first two remastered BioShock games.

about: Experiment with tools for sculpting scenes, animating characters and building interactive experiences.

Tutorials introduce the creative process, while the collection of tools lets you combine visuals, sound and logic into projects of your own. PSVR is optional with the VR update; support depends on the selected creation.
CUSA04301.summary: Create playable worlds, characters, music and art.

about: Guide a national team through the UEFA Euro 2016 tournament in this standalone football release. The competition brings its teams and presentation into the match play of Pro Evolution Soccer 2016.
CUSA04577.summary: Take European national teams through UEFA Euro 2016.

about: Glide over rooftops and investigate the walled streets of Arkham City as Batman.
Track a conspiracy through a sprawling prison district, balancing gadget puzzles, stealth encounters and close combat in the PS4 remaster of the second Arkham adventure.
CUSA04602.summary: Take the fight across a prison district ruled by Gotham’s villains.

about: Explore Arkham Asylum after the Joker turns its inmates against Batman.
Combine detective work, stealth and flowing close combat, using familiar gadgets to reach hidden areas and confront Gotham’s villains in the PS4 remaster of Arkham Asylum.
CUSA04744.summary: Outwit the Joker inside Gotham’s most dangerous asylum.

about: Choose a pair of fighters with distinctive abilities and explore interactive arenas in an original story involving the Joestar family. Combine attacks and special moves to overcome rival teams.
Specific DLC characters and other optional content are not individually verified.
CUSA04909.summary: Team up characters from across JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure for two-on-two fights.

about: Choose your path as the Dragonborn, undertaking quests and confronting dragons across a vast fantasy province.
CUSA05486.summary: Explore the open world of Skyrim.

about: Train performers and guide their careers in a music simulation.
CUSA05706.summary: Produce a new generation of idols.

about: Guide the colourful LocoRoco through twisting landscapes by tipping their world. Search for hidden passages, rescue MuiMui and gather materials for their growing home.
This PS4 remaster brings back the sequel’s musical adventure as the Moja army returns with a life-draining song.
CUSA07183.summary: Tilt, roll and sing your way through a world threatened by the Moja.

about: Build a deck and lead units into multiplayer fights in a fantasy strategy card game.
CUSA07284.summary: Command a champion in strategic arena battles.

about: Return as BJ Blazkowicz to recruit allies and challenge the occupying regime. Explore heavily defended locations, combine weapons and fight through a campaign built around the struggle to spark a new revolution.
CUSA07377.summary: Join the resistance in an alternate America under Nazi occupation.

about: Guide Knack through action challenges and environmental puzzles, changing size as relics reshape his body. Learn an expanded set of moves and work through encounters involving machinery, enemies and obstacles.
CUSA07670.summary: Grow, shrink and puzzle your way through an adventure.

about: Work with the thirteen idols of 765 Production as their producer and prepare them for the ambitious Stella Stage concert. A new story follows their progress while a newcomer from rival 961 Production stands in their path.
CUSA07753.summary: Lead 765 Production toward its legendary Stella Stage.

about: Pursue an ancient artefact while a ruthless war profiteer closes in. Explore ruins, solve intricate mechanisms and navigate combat encounters as an uneasy partnership develops between two determined adventurers.
CUSA07875.summary: Join Chloe and Nadine on a dangerous search through India’s Western Ghats.

about: Explore interconnected landscapes with Jak and Daxter, uncovering the secrets of Eco and ancient Precursor technology. Collect power cells, solve traversal challenges and confront the forces corrupting their world.
CUSA07934.summary: Help Jak reverse his friend’s transformation in an imaginative platforming world.

about: Master rhythm routines across songs and music videos.
CUSA08026.summary: Perform an expanded Hatsune Miku collection.

about: Fight through crowds of enemies as familiar Gintama characters and revisit anime story arcs in Gintama Chronicles. Each playable fighter has an Awakening Rumble attack that changes the pace of battle when its conditions are met.
CUSA08279.summary: Turn Gintama’s biggest clashes into a battlefield rumble.

about: Kowloon’s Gate VR: Suzaku recreates the unsettling atmosphere of the original game’s walled city as an exploratory experience. Wander its dense alleys, take in the unusual sights and meet strange inhabitants.
This entry focuses on visiting that world rather than retelling the original adventure.
CUSA08294.summary: Explore the strange streets of Kowloon in virtual reality.

about: Explore a zombie-filled Willamette and use improvised weapons in this Dead Rising adventure.
CUSA08558.summary: Frank West returns to investigate an outbreak.

about: Cross a vast, quiet land in search of sixteen colossi. Study each creature, climb its immense body and discover where to strike in this rebuilt PlayStation 4 adventure.
CUSA08809.summary: Face towering creatures across a forbidden landscape.

about: Equip a wingsuit and a customizable grappling hook to explore an expansive action sandbox.
Experiment with vehicles, weapons and improvised movement as Rico Rodriguez battles hostile forces and creates spectacular chain reactions across the landscape.
CUSA09254.summary: Turn an open-world battlefield into your own explosive playground.

about: Play the original Devil May Cry trilogy with updated high-definition presentation.
Compete in a board-game adventure featuring characters from Dragon Quest and Final Fantasy.
CUSA09572.summary: Roll the dice with two famous RPG casts.

about: Explore SEGA’s classic console library across platformers, fighting games, puzzles, shooters and role-playing adventures.
Revisit familiar characters and discover lesser-known games, with convenient saving, rewind and adjustable controls for a new generation of players.
CUSA09771.summary: Rediscover a collection of Mega Drive and Genesis favourites.

about: A strange gauntlet from an underwater temple pulls Jesse and familiar friends into another adventure. Make story choices, meet new companions and face the consequences of a world that now sees Jesse as a hero.
CUSA10678.summary: Follow Jesse into a new mystery beyond the Wither Storm.

about: A first-person shooter built around Specialist abilities, team combat and Zombies scenarios.
Black Ops 4 replaces the traditional single-player campaign with a collection of combat modes; available repack content and online functionality are described separately.
CUSA11100.summary: Build your loadout around distinctive Specialist abilities.

about: Explore islands, gather materials and create settlements alongside your companion Malroth in a block-building RPG.
CUSA11230.summary: Build a world against the forces of destruction.

about: Explore colonial cities and the frontier as Connor becomes involved in the conflict surrounding the American Revolution.
Move between stealth, exploration and open combat through a story that links an Assassin’s personal struggle with the upheaval around him.
CUSA11560.summary: Follow Connor through a remastered American Revolution.

about: Create a custom hero and join characters from famous manga series in a crossover fighting adventure.
Assemble a team, learn signature attacks and battle through an original story where fictional worlds collide with familiar locations on Earth.
CUSA11638.summary: Bring iconic manga fighters together to defend the real world.

about: Rescue captives and confront terrorists in a first-person arcade action game. Punch, kick and use weapons against opponents while earning experience to strengthen your character.
CUSA11732.summary: Fight your way through an occupied building.

about: Challenge other players in a PlayLink quiz built around entertainment and popular culture. Answer questions, compete in touch-screen challenges and use Power Plays to influence the contest as you climb the Pyramid of Knowledge.
CUSA12356.summary: Test pop-culture knowledge across four decades.

about: Travel as Sam through isolated landscapes transformed by a mysterious catastrophe. Plan routes, manage cargo and overcome the terrain as you work to rebuild connections between scattered communities.
CUSA12605.summary: Reconnect a fractured world one delivery at a time.

about: After a betrayal leaves him hunted, Agent 47 moves through guarded locations and a corrupt criminal world. Observe patrols, use disguises and choose how to approach each mission in this stealth-action adventure.
CUSA12650.summary: Guide Agent 47 through a dangerous pursuit for redemption.

about: Travel with a young boy hoping to reverse a tragedy that changed his life. Meet allies, confront strange creatures and explore a fantasy realm brought to PS4 through this remastered role-playing adventure.
CUSA13079.summary: Join Oliver on a magical journey to another world.

about: Revisit classic SNK games in an anniversary anthology spanning action, shooting and other arcade styles. The collection brings historical presentation and modern conveniences to games from the company’s early catalogue.
CUSA13229.summary: Explore a collection drawn from SNK’s early arcade history.

about: Make choices and explore character routes in a visual-novel adventure.

Choose from current players and basketball legends for arcade matches on courts around the world. Use dramatic moves and power-ups, challenge the single-player season, or compete with friends locally in a colorful take on street basketball.
CUSA13619.summary: Bring exaggerated dunks and quick two-on-two action to the playground.

about: Combine sword combat, stealth and agile traversal as a shinobi facing formidable enemies. Adapt prosthetic tools to different threats and study your opponents to find openings in demanding confrontations.
CUSA13801.summary: Fight to restore your honor in a dark vision of Sengoku Japan.

about: Explore the city, complete missions and use an arsenal of vehicles and weapons in an over-the-top open-world action game.
CUSA14350.summary: Lead the Saints through a remastered Steelport.

about: Horror SENSE turns a childhood stop-and-go game into a VR horror experience. Trapped in an abandoned school, advance through frightening encounters while trying not to move at the wrong moment.
Search for clues and a way out as your companions disappear. Requires a PSVR headset to play.
CUSA14482.summary: Keep still to survive a terrifying game in an abandoned school.

about: Explore a dangerous sandbox after being thrown out of a retirement home. Attempt reckless challenges, experiment with everyday objects and embrace slapstick mishaps while chasing a place to spend your remaining years.
CUSA14630.summary: Cause absurd chaos as a retiree in a world that has forgotten you.

about: Lead a crossover army through turn-based tactical battles.
CUSA14934.summary: Command another generation of super robots.

about: Kazuma Kiryu has left Tokyo's criminal world to run an orphanage in Okinawa, but a struggle over the surrounding land pulls him back into conflict.
Explore Okinawa and Kamurocho, fight street battles and take on side stories in the PS4 remaster of Yakuza 3.
CUSA15325.summary: Protect an Okinawan orphanage from a growing conspiracy.

about: Follow Ichiban Kasuga after his release from prison as he investigates the betrayal that destroyed his former life.
Recruit allies, develop their jobs and abilities, and fight through turn-based RPG encounters amid the distractions of Yokohama.
CUSA16734.summary: Build an unlikely party on Yokohama’s streets.

about: Battle with WWE Superstars and Legends in exaggerated, interactive arenas. Use special abilities and power-ups, work through a comic-style story and customize characters and battlegrounds for a range of wrestling match types.
CUSA16767.summary: Turn wrestling matches into an arcade brawl.
